These Pumpkin Spice Granola Bites are the perfect real food snack for little hands: soft inside, naturally sweet, and packed with quality fiber, rich protein & pure pumpkin. No sugar, no junk ...just calm, cozy snack time. Ingredients: 3/4 cup (70 g) rolled oats 2 tbsp (20g) ground seeds (sunflower, sesame & pumpkin) 1/4 tsp mixed spices (cinnamon + ginger+ nutmeg) 1/2 cup(120 g) pumpkin purée 1/4 cup(50 g) applesauce 1 tbsp date syrup 1egg How to make: 1. Mix until sticky but not wet. 2. Shape into small bites. 3.Bake at 180°C(350°F) for 15 min until golden outside,soft inside. #toddlersnacks #blwsnacks #healthykidssnacks #pumpkinrecipes #realfoodmama
